# Displacement

<!-- STEP id="net" -->
**Displacement** is the net change in position between two instants. From t = 0 s to t = 16 s, she moved from O to B: 40 m in the positive direction.

<!-- STEP id="compare" -->
Displacement has a magnitude (its size, here 40 m) and a direction. Distance and displacement are both measured in metres (m).

**Distance counts every metre; displacement joins the start to the end.**
